readability.reads_as: wave: the hand goes up and swings side to side, the strip rolling with the swing
readability.note: Rises 0.55 -> 0.73 m, then swings 0.35 m across (AUDIENCE SIDE ghosts 4-8) with the strip fanning (J6 range 55, strip tip 1.32 m/s vs TCP 0.75), aim kept on one person (facing 0.94). Same shape as greet_01_wave (0.35 m across), 0.6 m lower.

audience.note: The swing is broadside to the audience and in front of the arm; the hand is at 0.73 m (under the guests' eyes) but the strip's upper end waves at ~1.25 m.
